extracted.intended_audience: NLP/IR researchers and developers working on regulatory question-answering (RegNLP)
extracted.subtask_description: Creating datasets, retrieval components, and answer-generation systems for regulatory documents; includes automatically generating question–passage pairs from financial regulations and evaluating generated answers for obligation coverage and contradiction avoidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Question–passages pair generation
rubrics_metrics.description: "Generating question-passages pairs, where questions are automatically created and paired with relevant regulatory passages, facilitating the development of regulatory question-answering systems."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quality criteria implied: questions should be automatically generated from regulations and correctly paired with the passages that contain the relevant regulatory information. Relevance and faithful linkage between question and passage are core goals; systems should produce pairs that are useful for training and evaluating RegNLP models.

rubrics_metrics.name: ObliQA dataset composition and provenance
rubrics_metrics.description: "We create the ObliQA dataset, containing 27,869 questions derived from the collection of Abu Dhabi Global Markets (ADGM) financial regulation documents."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dataset quality criteria: domain-specific provenance (ADGM financial regulations), scale (27,869 questions), and traceability to source documents. Implication: datasets should preserve links to original regulatory text and reflect realistic obligations from the target regulatory corpus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Baseline RIRAG system (Regulatory Information Retrieval and Answer Generation)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Design a baseline Regulatory Information Retrieval and Answer Generation (RIRAG) system."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design criterion: combine effective retrieval of relevant regulatory passages with answer-generation tailored to regulatory language and obligations. Baseline systems should demonstrate the pipeline from retrieval to answer generation and serve as a point of comparison for future models.

rubrics_metrics.name: RePASs evaluation metric: obligation coverage and contradiction avoidance
rubrics_metrics.description: "RePASs, a novel evaluation metric that tests whether generated answers accurately capture all relevant obligations while avoiding contradictions."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluation dimensions: (1) completeness — does the generated answer capture all relevant obligations in the source passage(s); (2) consistency/non-contradiction — the answer must not contradict the regulations. RePASs is presented as an evaluation focused on both capturing obligations exhaustively and ensuring the answer does not introduce conflicting statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulatory document challenges to address
rubrics_metrics.description: "Regulatory documents, ... are characterized by their length, complexity and frequent updates, [and] are challenging to interpret, requiring significant allocation of time and expertise ..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: System and dataset criteria implied: methods must handle long, complex documents; be robust to frequent updates; and reduce the need for extensive domain expertise to interpret obligations. Practical evaluation should consider scalability to long texts, ability to capture nuanced rule language, and adaptability to document changes.
